facts.statement: Fane, waiting near the teleport stone at the Sanctuary, challenges players to beat his speed record in a race.
facts.quote: Fane attend près de la pierre de téléportation au Sanctuaire pour quelqu'un de battre son record de vitesse.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (post: A La Rencontre de Fane!)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news post announcing a racing challenge from an NPC named Fane, who waits by the teleport stone at the Sanctuary to race players and holds a speed record. The race starts at the mall and palace and ends back with Fane. The post gives no date beyond a relative timestamp.
